_comment: Self-documenting settings manifest (not a Duda-imposed format). Each entry is one Content Editor field read off data.config.<key>. Duda sends text as strings and toggles as booleans (or the text true/false); settings.ts accepts both. A blank field is not sent and uses its default. Generated from the duda-ai-prompt-1..3 files, which the settings test keeps in step.

fields.label: Intro text
fields.default: Work out your take-home pay. Rates are for the {taxYear} financial year.
fields.help: Short line under the title. Type {taxYear} to show the tax year automatically.

fields.label: Study loan label
fields.default: I have a HELP or study loan

fields.label: Package includes super help text
fields.default: The amount I entered already includes employer super. It is taken out before tax.

fields.label: Take-home summary heading
fields.help: Shown above the four take-home boxes.

fields.label: Row: total package
fields.help: Only shown when "My package includes super" is ticked.

fields.label: Row: employer super
fields.help: Type {superRate} to show the super rate automatically.

fields.label: Message: amount missing
fields.default: Enter a pay amount greater than zero.

fields.label: Message: hours not valid
fields.default: Enter hours per week between 1 and 168.

fields.label: Message: days not valid
fields.default: Enter days per week between 1 and 7.

fields.label: Tax year note
fields.help: Small line under the results. Type {taxYear} to show the tax year automatically.

fields.label: Guide-only statement
fields.default: This calculator is a guide only. It estimates take-home pay from the standard {taxYear} Australian rates and does not allow for the Medicare levy surcharge, family or senior thresholds, other offsets, salary sacrifice, bonuses or other income. Your actual pay may differ. Some {taxYear} thresholds are still awaiting final legislation. It is not tax or financial advice.
fields.help: Always shown under the results and cannot be switched off. Blank uses the default wording. Type {taxYear} to show the tax year automatically.

fields.label: Show tax options
fields.help: Off hides the whole Tax options group. Tax is still worked out as an Australian resident with no study loan and super not included.

fields.label: Show residency option
fields.help: Off hides this option inside Tax options and ignores it.

fields.label: Show study loan option
fields.help: Off hides this option inside Tax options and ignores it.

fields.label: Show package includes super option
fields.help: Off hides this option inside Tax options and ignores it.

fields.label: Show tax breakdown
fields.help: Off hides income tax, Medicare levy, study loan and super lines so only gross salary and take-home pay show.

fields.label: Show employer super line
fields.help: Employer super is shown on its own line under take-home pay. Only used while the tax breakdown is on.

fields.label: Starting pay amount
fields.help: Leave blank to start empty. A number calculates as soon as the page loads.

fields.label: Starting days per week
fields.help: Used for daily pay and the per-day figures.
